description: The agent doc .agent/docs/dispatch-matrix.md still describes collect_protocol_dispatch_matrix_candidates and protocol direct-call/residual outcomes as if an old planner producer exists. Current compiler2 code owns protocol selection in jobs/semantic.rs as CallSiteSummary targets, and fz-bin lowers multi-target callsites after semantic closure. Update the doc to name the real producer/consumer boundary: semantic resolves targets, the artifact call-edge builder constructs a PatternDispatchPlan over CallSiteSummary.surface_inputs, and outcomes remain opaque arm ids mapped to existing impl call targets outside DispatchMatrix. This is documentation cleanup for the arc; no production behavior change.
title: Docs: refresh dispatch-matrix protocol section for callsite-owned compiler2 dispatch
